tagData.title: teams
tagData.name: Teams
tagData.description: A team section of a website is important to highlight the team that is behind the project. It helps customers connect with the people who are involved in the project or product.  The team section can help customers see that there is more to the website than just their product. A good example of this is how Amazon does it on their homepage - they present their product, Alexa, as a part of Amazon.
